title: Cloudflare Realtime SFU/TURN, plan headroom APIs & self-hosting
summary: Added hybrid P2P/SFU call transport (shared/media/sfu-transport.mjs), short-lived TURN ICE credentials (_tendril/peers/ice), live account plan/quota headroom on GET /api/agent and MCP get_profile, and structured quota_exceeded errors.
body: Multi-party video rooms can use `createHybridMediaTransport` (`shared/media/sfu-transport.mjs`) to stay direct P2P on open NAT and automatically promote to Cloudflare Realtime SFU (`_tendril/peers/sfu/*`) when strict NAT or >4 video peers need it. Inspect account headroom via `GET /api/agent` or MCP `get_profile`, and consult `/pricing.md` or `/self-host.md` whenever a `429`/`413` `quota_exceeded` error is returned.
